title: Structured State Envelope (SSE) — SSP v2.0
description: Typed semantic state representation for the Session State Pipeline (SSP). Absorbs the DSR v0.1 schema and extends it with trajectory, instruction nodes, regulatory state, and consolidation fields.

envelope_version.description: Version of the SSE schema. SSP v2.0 uses '2.0'.

session_id.description: Unique identifier for this session. Format: sess_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_[4-char random].

parent_session_id.description: Null for root sessions. Set for forks.

fork_depth.description: 0 for root sessions. Incremented on each fork.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this envelope was created.

consolidation_timestamp.description: When Consolidate completed. Null if consolidation was skipped.

model_id.description: Identifier of the model used at extraction (e.g., 'claude-3.7', 'gpt-5-2026-04').

track.description: Fidelity track. 'sls' = native KV-cache, 'dsr' = semantic extraction.

schema_ref.description: Schema version pinned at extraction time (semver).

schema_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the schema at extraction time. Used for tamper detection.

task_summary.description: Short human-readable summary of the overall task.

fidelity_level.description: 3 = structured state (DSR standard). 4 = + critical excerpts. 5 = native KV-cache (SLS).

artifact_registry.description: Registry of files, documents, or artifacts referenced in the session.

decision_log.description: Log of key decisions made during the session.

working_model.description: Optional verbatim excerpts for Level 4 envelopes.

trajectory.description: Direction of the session — where it was going, not just where it was.

current_direction.description: The active investigative vector at extraction time.

momentum.description: Number of consecutive turns moving along the current direction.

closed_paths.description: Branches that were explicitly ruled out or abandoned.

open_branches.description: Branches still being explored at extraction time.

instruction_nodes.description: Pending procedural operations and constraints at extraction time.

regulatory_state.description: Session-level traversal pattern and cognitive state at extraction.

window_bandwidth.description: Session bandwidth signature. Determines consolidation depth.

open_closed_ratio.description: Ratio of closed loops to open branches at consolidation.

consolidation_depth.description: Consolidation depth used. Null if not consolidated.

peak_window_turns.description: Turns where the session ran at peak window width.

rebase_history.description: Node IDs that have served as root, in sequence.

bandwidth_trajectory.description: Direction of window width at extraction.

non_regenerable_diff.description: The typed semantic diff that Restore operates against. This is the operational field — the pipeline does not use the full envelope for rehydration.

artifact_hmac.description: HMAC of the full artifact. Computed at persist time. Validated before any read or write.
